title: Pentacles in tarot: Six to Ten meanings
description: The Six to Ten of Pentacles in tarot: upright and reversed meanings for generosity, patience, craft, self-sufficiency and legacy, as prompts for reflection.

scenes.headline: Pentacles in tarot: Six to Ten meanings
scenes.caption: The Six to Ten of Pentacles cover giving, patience, skill, comfort and legacy, the steadier and more settled half of the earth suit.
scenes.vo: The Six to Ten of Pentacles cover giving, patience, skill, comfort and legacy, the steadier and more settled half of the earth suit.

scenes.headline: Six of Pentacles
scenes.caption: Generosity, giving and receiving, fairness. A well-dressed figure holds scales and gives coins to two kneeling people.
scenes.vo: Six of Pentacles. Generosity, giving and receiving, fairness. A well-dressed figure holds scales and gives coins to two kneeling people.

scenes.headline: Seven of Pentacles
scenes.caption: Patience, assessment, long-term effort. A gardener leans on a hoe and looks at a bush heavy with pentacles.
scenes.vo: Seven of Pentacles. Patience, assessment, long-term effort. A gardener leans on a hoe and looks at a bush heavy with pentacles.

scenes.headline: Eight of Pentacles
scenes.caption: Diligence, craftsmanship, learning a skill. A craftsperson sits at a bench, carving pentacles one by one, with finished ones on display.
scenes.vo: Eight of Pentacles. Diligence, craftsmanship, learning a skill. A craftsperson sits at a bench, carving pentacles one by one, with finished ones on display.
